svg.text: d2s_out_n: the two N clamp frames of the pad
layout: 2 x Clamp_N_M1 ng 35, l 1u, 80u, wiring external; the upper one with Clamp_N_M1_wiring roles 16:rep 17:rep
ON: 33 + 35 = 68 fingers, gate b, drain vout (the pad). RN1: the replica of ON, the centre pair of the upper frame (2 f), diode-connected on dabn.
